contract.note: The population, general tendency, and ordinary meaning of maintenance difficulty are fair. The October 1 boundary has no basis in the statement and unduly restricts relevant observations. Population and maintenance-outcome gaps leave the claim unresolved even without that restriction.

evidence.note: This preprint fits its stated contextual role and predates the cutoff. Its mixed populations and selected accounts do not establish recurring maintenance difficulty across substantial amateur-built products.
